description:
Project: New website — e-commerce

Business: Souhoud, sells school supplies (notebooks, books, bags, suitcases, etc.).

Goal: Sell school supplies directly to customers online.

Website kind: Online store

Key features:
- Online payments / secure checkout
- Product catalog / gallery

Design & brand:
- Colors: Sky blue
- Mood: Fun
- Signature (what the site is remembered by): The go-to place for school supply shopping.
- First impression / photos & logo: Studio will create the visual look and provide images, no existing photos provided.

designManifest.summary: A school-supply store, so the page is a notebook: sky-blue ruled lines and one coral margin line open the hero and every section head, mark the current page and separate ideas; sunshine-yellow stickers carry prices and badges; rounded Baloo 2 display type keeps it fun.
designManifest.heroThesis: A promise in six words — « La rentrée, sans le stress. » — over the ruled page, with the shop and the grade lists offered side by side, because a parent either browses or wants the whole list in one click.
designManifest.signatureMove: The ruled-paper background with its coral margin (--ruled), reused for the hero, section rules, category tiles and every image placeholder; a rotated yellow sticker for every price.
designManifest.typography: Baloo 2 700/800 for display, Nunito 400/700/800 for body and UI.
designManifest.copyVoice: Warm, direct second-person French for parents; English mirrors it at the same brevity.
designManifest.iconDirection: Studio flat-vector illustrations in one style: sky blue and sunshine yellow on notebook paper, generic kinds of school supplies, never a photograph of a specific product.

promptHistory.prompt: Build this tenant's online school-supply store from the signup brief (no source site, no photos, no catalogue).
promptHistory.changeNotes: Initial hand build. 12 bilingual pages, 7 categories, a 25-product starter catalogue with every price marked unconfirmed, 4 school lists with one-click add-all, a server-priced cart with GST/QST, PayPal checkout, order tracking, and a 6-module admin console with a launch checklist. 39 studio illustrations generated in one style. Verified by booting against pglite with the full seed (63/63 probes), Playwright at 1440 and 390 with zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors.
